Application Data.NAME: Precision Engineering Solutions Inc.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Precision Engineering Solutions Inc. specializes in providing comprehensive engineering and surveying services, including civil engineering design, land surveying, and construction project management. Our operations encompass site assessments, feasibility studies, and environmental impact evaluations, ensuring project compliance with local regulations. We leverage advanced technology, such as GIS and CAD software, to enhance accuracy and efficiency in our deliverables. Our experienced team prioritizes safety and risk management, adhering to stringent protocols during all phases of project execution. We are committed to maintaining high professional standards and regularly update our safety documentation and training protocols to mitigate potential liabilities.
